text_block_list.text:
The day has finally come for the Arima
Kinen, the
last big race of the senior
year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер is no longer the timid girl
she once
was. Determined to shine
brighter than anyone
else...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She sets out for the Arima Kinen, where
great
runners await her—Токай Тэйо
among them.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
